task: identify wheat leaf diseases (8 classes) from images

task: detect freeway traffic accidents in real time from loop-detector and weather data

task: classify chemical compounds as good or poor transdermal enhancers (ER > 10)

task: diagnose cancer (laryngeal, bladder, colorectal) from microarray gene expression

task: classify the copper flotation method (preferential, partial, mixed) for process design
note: Abstract only, but it says the training set's minority categories were oversampled by SMOTE (FT fields left na). XGBoost tuned by TPE; proposed 'evaluation set validation' replaces CV on a small sample.

task: identify risk factors and classify gestational diabetes in pregnant women
note: Abstract only. One local hospital data set (Mysuru, India); wrapper feature subset selection; k-means clustering also used. Split or CV not described in the abstract; accuracy only.

task: predict prostate cancer stage (organ-confined vs extraprostatic) from biopsy data
note: No unresampled baseline. Train size (70%) chosen by test performance. 'Simulated' PCa validation data were generated by undersampling+SMOTE. UCI breast and lung sets are other tasks, not external validation.

task: identify patchouli plant varieties from leaf images
note: Authors attribute better precision/recall to 'the increase in the number of test data in classes P, S and T'. SMOTE applied to 14 handcrafted leaf features. Abstract says 93 images, text 91.

task: identify risk factors for and predict cardiac implantable device infection
note: Also logistic risk-factor analysis on a randomly under/oversampled cohort (n=739). F1 rises from about 20% to 93% after SMOTE, computed on SMOTE-balanced validation data. Original data also expanded proportionally to 165%.

task: detect web spam pages (WEBSPAM-UK2007)
note: Abstract only. SMOTE then random forest, compared with single and ensemble classifiers and the Web Spam Challenge 2008 best AUC. Parameters 'optimized based on experimental results'; abstract does not say on which data.

task: semantic segmentation of urban aerial LiDAR point clouds fused with aerial images
note: B2: class-targeted flip augmentation (patches >70% minor/medium points; H flip medium, H+V flip minor), not SMOTE; resampling is a side experiment (Sec. 5.3), contribution is PMNet. Weighted softmax cross-entropy used in all models, not compared.

task: classify sentiment of tweets about Islamophobia after the Christchurch attack
note: Sec. 2 says generically SMOTE balances 'the original training set', but placement relative to 10-fold CV is not stated; codes rest on rule-D arithmetic. Labels from VADER. Web app built, no results from use.

task: identify opinion leaders in a cyclist community from questionnaire answers
note: Train and test sets both built from the same 120 respondents, labelled differently (score cut-off vs peer votes); no split described. Table 3 accuracy 50% at zero recall hints at a balanced test set. HDDT compared, not cost-sensitive.

task: classify relations between entity pairs in news and Wikipedia text (distant supervision)
note: New classifier APCNN with OWA loss; random oversampling of rare relations to at least 1:5, plus inverse-frequency loss weights (combined, not compared). Ablation without resampling reported only in words (vs_none). Test labels re-checked against knowledge bases.

task: detect abnormal states of stock-market trading system components from log statistics
note: Abstract only. Oversampling method not named (coded other). Domain software (IT operations of a trading platform), not finance. Bagging also used; Info Gain feature selection; best accuracy and ROC with C4.5 and RF on oversampled features.

task: classify Golgi-resident proteins as cis-Golgi or trans-Golgi from sequence features
note: With SMOTE, CV Acc/MCC (.864/.728) fit balanced 217/217 folds, not natural 87/217 (.860/.688). Independent test set (13/51, from Ding et al.) keeps natural distribution; coded external. Features also selected by CV accuracy.

task: na

task: predict risk of Crohn's disease-related surgery
note: Random split of 1524 events from 239 patients; patient-level separation not stated. RF attribute reselection on the original full data. Interplay of 9:1 split and 10-fold CV loosely described. Accuracy and TN-rate formulas misprinted.

task: classify water coverage ratio level (6 classes) from PEM fuel cell gas-channel images
note: Oversampled copies (classes 3-6) get flip/lighting augmentation (other); classes 1-2 randomly undersampled; all to 3500. Before-split rests on the described order (pre-processing, then 'the data set' split), no explicit sentence. Confusion matrices also shown.

task: classify neuroblastoma histopathological images into tumour classes
note: Abstract only: oversampling methods and classifiers not named (resampler other = unnamed oversampling; learner na). Multi-class; accuracy over 90% versus 84% in earlier work on the same data.

task: detect air pressure system (APS) failures in Scania trucks to cut maintenance cost
note: inside_folds nr: SMOTE on the training set, before the tuning CV; data behind scores not stated. Conclusion claims before/after-SMOTE results, but one cost score per classifier is reported. Measure: cost 10*FP+500*FN. Domain could be transport.

task: classify breast cancer data set instances (target not stated)
note: Abstract only: data sets, the five classifiers and the measures are not named (learner, measures na). PCA plus SMOTE, then an ensemble of the best classifiers. Tabular modality assumed from PCA on high-dimensional data.

task: flag fraudulent motor insurance claims
note: Contribution is fraud pipeline (ADASYN+SVM), compared with SMOTE and SMOTE+RF of [3]; ADASYN unchanged, so application. Split never described; conclusion figures (93% to 98% accuracy) contradict Sec. IV (88.5% to >90%).

task: predict conductor galloping on overhead power lines from weather features
note: 'Smart sampling' is plain SMOTE and random undersampling. Resampling is described on 'the dataset' alongside a 25% random test split, so before-split leakage is possible but not stated. Fig. 9 compares raw data, oversampling, undersampling.

task: predict MOOC learners' employment status from their written texts
note: Abstract only. A 'widely used oversampling method' (unnamed) is compared with generative paraphrasing augmentation; both coded other. Paraphrasing may be the authors' own method. Domain could be social (author profiling).

task: classify students' text feedback into categories
note: Abstract only; classifiers not named (learner na). Three student-feedback text data sets (ASS, FDS, NASS); reports gains in average per-class recall and minority-class recall.

task: classify autism spectrum disorder vs typical development from resting-state fMRI
note: Abstract only. Cluster-then-SMOTE (hierarchical clustering) on selected R-fMRI features, described as adopted not proposed (borderline application). Accuracy 59.70% to 66.62% versus imbalanced multi-centre data.

task: segment satellite images into village, mountain and river areas
note: Pixels resampled using ground-truth labels, then fuzzy clustering (FCM, possibilistic c-means) of two satellite images, scored on the same images (resubstitution): no split, so inside_folds and validation nr. Confusion matrices also reported.

task: classify Alzheimer's disease stage (4 classes) from brain MRI
note: Overview (Sec. II) says the data are split after oversampling, contradicting Sec. II-B and the arithmetic. Oversampling = rotated/flipped copies of minority classes (other). Predefined Kaggle train/test folders.

task: classify Indonesian e-learning feedback texts into six categories
note: Best model (LSTM, macro-F1 64.35%) used no oversampling; ROS beat SMOTE. SMOTE applied to tokenized integer sequences. Hyperparameters compared for the best test-set result. Domain could be software (bug reports, feature requests).

task: detect breast cancer from thermograms
note: Abstract only; classifier not named (learner na). Preprocessing module combines standardisation, SMOTE and undersampling (no new resampler). 'Area Under Curve' coded ROC-AUC.

task: classify network traffic as normal or attack type
note: Plain GAN (MLP, standard loss) in controller loop: B2 application, though weak-class allocation could count as new. No SMOTE; only vs no resampling. Weak classes chosen from reported test F1 (Table III), whose supports mostly equal full-data counts.

task: identify DNA-binding residues in protein sequences
note: Modality other: protein-sequence windows (PSSM/one-hot/PSA). ADASYN plus bootstrap undersampling into CNN voting ensemble, no resampling comparison (rule B). Before-split rests on arithmetic; text says ADASYN in training phase, 'testing phase same as training'.

task: detect double-trigger and breath-stacking asynchrony in ventilator waveforms
note: Abstract only; ensemble classifier members not named (learner na). Breath-level data from 35 patients; abstract does not say whether evaluation separated patients.

task: na

task: diagnose aero-engine wear faults from spectral oil data via extracted rules
note: Proposes GA plus support-vector-clustering rule extraction; SMOTE only in the aero-engine oil application (classes 230/5/2). UCI benchmark experiments use no resampling. Domain industry (fault diagnosis), though aviation. Learner: rules from support vector clustering; other = rule support/confidence.

task: classify skin lesions as melanoma or benign
note: SMOTE x5 plus qualified majority voting within SFFS band selection; bands chosen on the same LOO results reported. SMOTE placement within LOO unstated; SVM tuned on whole balanced data. Modality: 55-band ROI spectral vectors.

task: predict DNase I hypersensitive sites in plant genomes
note: No abstract or full text; coded from title only. Resampling use not verifiable from title; is_application yes rests on E1 screening. DS evidence theory fusion; base learners unknown. Modality: DNA sequences.

task: identify collapsed buildings from post-earthquake satellite imagery
note: Random oversampling (no SMOTE), random undersampling and cost-sensitive loss compared with unbalanced SqueezeNet-style CNN. Spatially separate test regions of the same image coded internal. PA/UA per class mapped to recall/precision/specificity; UA non-collapsed (NPV) = other.

task: detect coronary artery disease from clinical and work-related features
note: Contribution is 2HFS feature selection and new Nasarian CAD dataset; SMOTE vs ADASYN on four CAD datasets. No proposed-without-balancing row; baselines differ in features. FS weights use test accuracy. Validation design undescribed (main text).

task: classify admitted patients by criticality (three levels)
note: Three-class criticality (low majority). SMOTE coupled with locally linear embedding; 'trimming' coded undersampling. Tenfold CV attributed to prior study (Rahman and Hasan 2011), own validation not stated. No measures named in abstract.

task: predict occupants' thermal comfort responses
note: Explores GAN-generated synthetic samples for class balancing; abstract does not say whether the GAN is the authors' own design or mention SMOTE; no learner, measures or validation named. Domain: built environment thermal comfort.

task: identify coal pay zones from drilling and LWD data
note: Six Surat Basin wells; multi-well experiments train on nearby wells and test a held-out well (spatial split of one study's data, coded internal). Domain coded energy (coal seam gas). Samples treated as tabular log features.

task: predict above-average postoperative length of stay after isolated CABG
note: No SMOTE: random over-, under-sampling, 'Both' (combined) and ROSE (coded other). Authors concede oversampling before the 70/30 split inflated AUC (0.89); resampling also preceded 10-fold CV. No unresampled baseline.

task: na
note: Not a domain application: proposes a generic imbalanced-data classifier (fuzzy C-means features plus Rotation Forest) using existing SMOTE; abstract names no domain or data set.

task: classify programmers' personality types from CI logs for suggestions
note: Title says 'novel SMOTE algorithm' but abstract says the authors 'adopt SMOTE' for imbalanced CI log data; coded application. Learner, measures, validation not named; log representation not described (coded tabular).

task: classify respondents as introvert or extrovert from survey items
note: SMOTE/ADASYN gained on validation but barely on test data, implying an unresampled comparison; check whether validation data were resampled. FT fields na. Domain: personality survey (coded other); stakes coded individual.

task: classify reader emotions in online news comments
note: Eight-class emotion labels from detik.com comments. Abstract reports SMOTE raised accuracy by up to 35% (implies unresampled comparison; FT fields na). Split or CV not stated.

task: detect phishing web pages
note: Abstract reports Borderline-SMOTE improved F-value and recall by 2% (implies unresampled comparison; FT fields na). Features: web document content plus other features (coded mixed). Validation not stated.

task: screen children for ADHD inattentive subtype from tablet game data
note: 39 children; nine classifiers, locally deep SVM best with LOOCV plus consensus algorithm. Results given with and without SMOTE; SMOTE applied 'on game segment data', placement relative to LOOCV unknown. Game-segment data coded tabular.

task: predict real-time crash likelihood on freeways
note: Matched case-control sampling fixes class ratio; RF for feature selection. 'Crash prediction accuracy' = share of crashes identified (coded recall); false alarm rate coded specificity. Also reports results on overall dataset including training data.

task: classify cases in an unnamed imbalanced medical dataset
note: Medical dataset and outcome not named. Random forests on under- and over-sampled subsamples; over-sampling type unspecified (coded random-oversampling). In- and out-of-sample evaluation coded internal; metrics not named. Stakes coded individual (medical classification).

task: predict node failures and failure types in cloud data centers
note: Oversampling type not named in abstract (resampler na); SCS-XGBoost combines oversampling with cost-sensitive learning. HW-GRU and CNN extract features from multivariate monitoring data. Measures and validation not stated.

task: predict polygonal wear degree of high-speed train wheels for maintenance
note: SMOTE-NC augments mixed nominal/continuous maintenance data; autoencoder features feed SVM, Bayesian-optimised. Railway wheel maintenance coded industry (transport plausible). Measures and validation design not stated (2016-2017 data).

task: predict defective software modules from code metrics
note: NASA MDP datasets. PSO feature selection plus RUS and SMOTE with bagged naive Bayes, compared against plain naive Bayes (p = 0.043); FT fields na. Validation design not stated.

task: classify prospective Hajj pilgrims' health capability (istitaah) from EHR
note: Algorithmic approach (AdaBoost etc.) compared with SMOTE; FT fields na. Accuracy named only qualitatively, no figures given. Purworejo District EHR data split into training and testing (internal).

task: screen children at risk of Chinese handwriting difficulties
note: Abstract only. Domain borderline medicine/education (clinical or teaching intervention). Features from tablet handwriting process data. Abstract says SMOTE significantly improved SVM sensitivity, implying a with/without comparison; evaluation design not stated.

task: diagnose power transformer fault types from dissolved gas analysis
note: Abstract only. Domain borderline energy/industry (equipment fault). Trained and tested on IEC TC 10 data plus Jakarta plant data; abstract unclear whether one source was a separate external test. Computation time also reported. SMOTE effect investigated.

task: classify semiconductor wafer defects in SEM images
note: Abstract only. Learner family not named ('ML models'), so learner na. 'Purity' coded as precision (ADC usage). Abstract reports with- versus without-SMOTE comparisons and SMOTE plus random undersampling; evaluation design not described.

task: predict default class of microcredit borrowers (three classes)
note: Abstract only. No measure named ('an additional set of metrics'), so measures na. Homogeneous and heterogeneous ensembles; only Consolidated Trees Construction and Rotation Forest named. Borrowers include micro and small enterprises.

task: classify whether Italian tweets (text and image) report flooding
note: Abstract only. Resampling is image data augmentation to oversample the minority class (coded other); no SMOTE named, so scope worth checking. Domain borderline social/environment. MediaEval 2020 run; evaluation design not described.

task: predict vancomycin-resistant enterococci infection in hospital patients
note: Abstract only (PhD thesis; one of three parts uses ML). Oversampling method unspecified (coded other). LASSO coded logistic. 30-month sliding window may imply temporal validation; not stated. Implemented in WASPSS CDSS without in-use results.

task: classify pediatric brain tumour type from MR spectroscopy
note: Abstract only. Five pattern recognition algorithms not named; AdaBoostM1 used as imbalance correction (coded boosting). Complete spectra (signal) and metabolite profiles (tabular) used as separate inputs (coded mixed). Oversampled versus original data compared; 90 patients.

task: classify entities into institutional sectors
note: Title only: no abstract and no full text. Resampling use, data, learner and evaluation cannot be verified; is_application yes rests only on the E1 exclusion. Domain (economic statistics) coded other. Needs the full text.

task: predict defective software modules
note: Abstract only. Applies existing A-SUWO (adaptive semi-unsupervised weighted oversampling), coded other-SMOTE-variant; the 'new framework' is the pipeline, not a new resampler. Other learners besides Random Forest not named. NASA defect data; evaluation design not described.

task: classify flights as late or on time
note: Abstract only and vague. Oversampling method unspecified (coded other); learner not named. Flight delay data (late versus on-time), modality assumed tabular. May be a generic oversampling demonstration rather than a domain application.

task: predict stability condition of transport soil embankment slopes
note: Abstract only. 'Oversampling' listed beside SMOTE coded random-oversampling; called 'training sampling approaches' and compared with no resampling. No measure named. Inputs are inspection-recorded visual features. Domain borderline transport/environment.

task: identify features and diagnose cardiac arrhythmia type
note: Abstract only. UCI arrhythmia data processed with random undersampling and SMOTE first, then elastic-net feature ranking and one-against-one multiclass SVM; abstract wording suggests the data set was resampled before evaluation, but the split is not described.

task: distinguish Parkinson's disease stages from PSP using gait parameters
note: Abstract only. Abstract order (SMOTE 'to balance our imbalanced dataset', then cross-validation to provide training and testing sets) suggests resampling before splitting; full text needed. 'Error' coded other. 46 subjects, three groups.

task: detect anomalies in cloud application KPI time series
note: Abstract only. VAE oversampling coded deep-generative; no SMOTE named. Evaluated on Yahoo A1/A2 benchmarks and production KPI data sets; unclear whether production data tested a fixed model (external) or were separate internal evaluations.

task: predict churn of fixed broadband internet customers
note: Abstract only. SMOTEBoost (SMOTE inside boosting rounds) coded other-SMOTE-variant. Feed-forward neural network used to remove noisy records; SMOTEBoost predicts. Abstract gives no results; accuracy mentioned only generically. Modality assumed tabular.

task: assess power system short-term voltage stability online from PMU trajectories
note: Abstract only (book chapter). FN-SMOTE is not described and may be the authors' own variant; if the chapter presents it as new, is_application should be no. Combined with cost-sensitive learning. Learner and measures not named. Nordic system and CSG tests.

task: classify emotions in Indonesian tweets
note: Abstract only. Best result with SMOTE quoted as F-measure 83.2% against 71.7% accuracy without SMOTE (different measures). Rule-based Synesketch coded other. 7622 tweets, seven classes; evaluation design not described.

task: predict breast cancer occurrence from risk factors
note: Abstract only. Balancing applied 'on the BCSC dataset before constructing' the models; best method then tested on validation data, whose resampling status is unclear. SpreadSubsample coded undersampling; Bayesian Network coded other. ROC curve coded ROC-AUC.

task: classify fraud instances and explain predictions
note: Abstract only. 'Novel solution' is existing SMOTE plus XAI (LRP, SHAP, LIME), not a new resampler. Fraud type and data set not stated; modality assumed tabular; unit of decision unclear, stakes coded other. Confusion matrices also reported.

task: predict households facing catastrophic out-of-pocket health expenditure

note: Cognitive-neuroscience task-state classification without a patient decision, coded bio; ICA component time courses classified by a Conv-GRU, coded time-series. SVM, logistic regression, LDA and KNN are baselines.

note: Abstract names no measure (measures na). SMOTE combined with AdaBoost to build SVM ensembles after binary decomposition: a pipeline using existing SMOTE, not a new resampler. Image forensics coded security.

task: flag fraudulent motor insurance claims
note: Near-perfect F1 (about 98%) and accuracy (99%) after SMOTE; evaluation design not stated. 'Cross-validated by industry experts' refers to a comparison with an extreme-value-theory actuarial model, not a data split.

task: detect web spam in the WEBSPAM-UK2007 data set
note: Abstract names no measure (measures na). It says SMOTE changes the imbalance ratio of the training set, suggesting training-only resampling. Nested Rotation Forest; tabular assumed, as Rotation Forest works on feature vectors.

task: estimate drivers' involvement in crash types by age group from crash attributes
note: Explanatory study: odds ratios from logistic regression after SMOTE-ENN balancing (measures other = odds ratios); no predictive performance or validation named. Imbalance described as few crash records of older drivers.

task: predict bankruptcy events
note: Oversampling method not named (coded other). Abstract does not say whether firms or persons go bankrupt; stakes coded other. Six classifiers compared on equal footing. Claims oversampling improves precision, so vs_none is likely yes.

task: predict overall survival after SBRT for hepatocellular carcinoma from MRI radiomics
note: Radiomic features from multiparametric MRI of 81 patients (19 deceased); modality coded image though the model sees feature vectors. Main comparison is feature-selection strategies; evaluation design not stated.

task: classify whether a patient has malaria
note: Abstract says SMOTE balanced the data first and 70% of the balanced data trained the model, the rest tested it: full text would likely give inside_folds before-split and test_balanced yes. 165 patients; Weka versus R comparison.

task: classify patients as healthy or epilepsy-affected
note: Abstract does not name the data type; time-series (EEG) assumed for seizure detection, check. SPIDER coded other. Abstract says balancing improved accuracy, so vs_none is likely yes in the full text.

task: classify news articles by relevance to regional communities
note: Oversampling method not named (coded other). Measures other = training and testing time. Oversampling tested as one option alongside Naive Bayes, Complement Naive Bayes and n-grams; Japanese prefectures as communities. No venue or DOI in record.

task: classify drug-drug, drug-adverse effect and drug-disease relations in biomedical text
note: Abstract names no measure (measures na). SMOTE balances the data before CNN modelling; CNN input is concatenated sentence feature embeddings. Abstract compares balanced with imbalanced training, so vs_none is likely yes. Cross-corpus training.

task: predict activity or inactivity of compounds in bioassays
note: Abstract names no measure (measures na). Main model optimized random forest; Bayes Net, naive Bayes, SMO, J48, AdaBoost, bagging and logistic regression also trained. Drug descriptors; several bioassay data sets.

task: predict mTOR inhibitor-like compounds from ChEMBL bioactivity data
note: The four classifiers are not named in the abstract (learner na). Models built on both imbalanced and SMOTE-balanced data, so vs_none is likely yes in the full text. Compound representation not stated; tabular assumed.

task: classify imbalanced handwritten digit images (MNIST)
note: Generic imbalanced-classification method (ResNet) shown only on MNIST, no domain application; coded yes because no codebook 'no' reason fits, but a checker may prefer no. Oversampling method not named (coded other).

task: predict defect-prone software modules
note: Classifiers and measures not named in the abstract (na). Random undersampling and SMOTE after feature selection, plus noise filters IPF and INFFC (not coded as resamplers). Scenario S2 has no balancing, so vs_none likely yes.

task: predict onset of type 2 diabetes from electronic health records
note: Abstract states SMOTE was applied within each cross-validation training fold (full text would likely give inside_folds stated) and reports the model without SMOTE (vs_none would be yes). SMOTE raised sensitivity, not AUC. Wide-and-deep network.

task: predict defective modules in cross-project software defect prediction
note: Abstract names no measure (measures na). Validation coded external because cross-project prediction, as the abstract defines it, tests on projects not used for training. PCA to two components before SMOTE; eight open-source projects.

task: classify Alzheimer's disease, mild cognitive impairment or control from biomarker combinations
note: kNN with random undersampling or SMOTE serves as the criterion of wrapper feature selection over biomarker combinations; compared with SVM and weighted kNN. Data source and evaluation design not stated; reports 94.34 ± 3.91% accuracy.

task: detect fraudulent credit card transactions
note: Preliminary study varying DNN depth, width and activations. Oversampling method not named (coded other); no measure named (measures na). Stakes individual as flags act on customers' transactions; checker may prefer other.

task: detect electricity theft by customers from smart-meter consumption data
note: SMOTE-Tomek applied to whole SGCC set (Table 2) before GridSearchCV; no held-out split described; benchmarks (SVM, LR, ADB, DT, KNN, GB) also on resampled data. Stakes individual: flags customers. Modality: daily consumption series.

task: diagnose coronary artery disease from clinical data
note: SMOTE in preprocessing on whole Z-Alizadeh Sani set (216/87), then extra-trees feature selection (36 features), then 10-fold CV; one sentence says SMOTE made 'training data' representative. ROC curves mentioned, not shown. Accuracy 95.16 (abstract) vs 95.79 (conclusion).

task: detect electricity theft by consumers
note: Abstract only. Theft samples are synthesised from benign consumption (attack models); not coded as resampling. Detection rate coded as recall, misclassification rate as other. Other learners unnamed.

task: predict 2-year major adverse cardiovascular events in acute coronary syndrome patients
note: Text says stratified 80/20 split, then sampling 'while training', but results are 'on balanced data' and metrics imply balanced test sets for all three samplers. Cluster Centroids coded undersampling. AUC equals (recall+specificity)/2 (hard labels).

task: predict coronary heart disease risk
note: Whole-data SMOTE read from pipeline order and post-SMOTE total (7,328) exceeding the original 4,240; per-class counts inconsistent. Sensitivity/specificity mentioned but only accuracy reported. Cleveland data also used.

task: classify smokers' HRV before vs after smoking (find key HRV predictor)
note: No train/test split or CV described; validation nr. Groups already balanced (20/20): SMOTE enlarged sample size; t-tests also on augmented data. Classifier used to find key HRV predictor, not for decisions about persons (stakes other).

task: predict compound inhibition of neglected tropical disease parasite targets
note: Not SMOTE: random over- and undersampling and sample weights compared on three PubChem assays, three splits averaged. FPR (1 minus specificity) coded as specificity. NN2 is a five-hidden-layer MLP.

task: detect lodged maize plots from UAV image features
note: Split 70:30 first; SMOTE-ENN then applied to training and testing sets (Table 5) as 'preliminary step' before tuning CV; before-split is the closest code. vs_none confounded: 'after' metrics on resampled test, 'before' on natural test.

task: predict mortality of heart failure patients
note: Contribution is IBS classifier (boosting plus stacking of DT, RF, GB with logistic meta-learner); SMOTE-ENN is a pre-processing step, not compared with other resampling, so application. Feature selection also on resampled whole data.

task: predict customer subscription to term deposit in bank telemarketing
note: Method text says 'training data is pre-processed', but SMOTE+RF confusion matrix covers whole resampled set (66,367), so CV on resampled data. Bank marketing coded business. ROC curve (Fig. 4) without AUC value.

task: classify sentiment of Indonesian tweets on electric vehicles
note: Conclusion says SMOTE balanced 'the training data', but diagonal counts imply a 1091-tweet test set drawn from SMOTE-balanced data. Labels from TextBlob polarity after translation (not human). No results without SMOTE.

task: predict stress of automobile drivers while driving
note: Fig. 1 puts oversampling in data preparation, but Sec. 4.2 states learning folds only. Nine SMOTE rates compared. RIPPER coded other; MLP stacks RF, J48, JRip. Signals plus questionnaire data: mixed. Driving-safety context: transport.

task: diagnose polycystic ovary syndrome from clinical screening features
note: Stated order contradicts numbers: accuracies 92.024/90.18/70.55% equal 150/147/115 of 163, and 163=30% of original 541 (30% of 728 would be 219); reported test set may be unresampled. Tables 1-4 not in text.

task: grade gliomas as high or low grade from brain MRI
note: 5-fold CV inside training ran on SMOTE-augmented sets (Table 4), so validation folds held synthetic LGG; reported results on untouched test sets. Diffusion-filter hyperparameters tuned on test datasets. ROC curves without AUC values.

task: detect fraudulent credit card transactions
note: Accuracy equals the mean of sensitivity and specificity in every row, so test data have equal class sizes. Sec. III.A garbled text appears to describe 1:1 undersampling (coded). Results per 'iteration'; no unresampled baseline.

task: recognize facial expressions (seven basic emotions) in face images
